company_name: Japan Electronics Packaging and Circuits Association
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Japan Electronics Packaging and Circuits Association is involved in the electronic circuit board sector, which is a critical component of the semiconductor value chain.
summary: The Japan Electronics Packaging and Circuits Association (JPCA) is focused on the electronic circuit board sector, providing updates on production trends and facilitating knowledge sharing among member companies. It organizes events and publishes resources to support innovation in circuit design and manufacturing.
capabilities: Updates on production trends for electronic circuit boards
Publication of industry insights through 'JPCA NEWS'
Organization of events like the Electronic Equipment Total Solution Exhibition

regional_presence.Japan: The association is based in Japan and focuses on the domestic electronic circuit board sector.
